business_problem: Fanatics wanted to help sports fans find coordinated, in-stock merchandise for game-day outfits across its online stores, while making relevant recommendations at the scale of its product catalogs.
solution_summary: Fanatics' Shop the Look uses OpenAI-powered recommendations to help shoppers complete outfits around a team jersey. The system draws on enriched product descriptions, team information, and inventory, then uses OpenAI models to select coordinated items; Fanatics' merchandising rules constrain results for compatibility and relevance. Recommendation tools built with Codex were used to enrich catalog data, find compatible merchandise, evaluate candidates, and generate looks. The experience surfaces in-stock selections on product pages across Fanatics.com and official NFL, NBA, MLB, and NHL stores, and refreshes recommendations daily as catalogs change. The story does not identify a persistent storage or model-hosting architecture. Fanatics tested roughly 30,000 MLB products before rollout; the feature achieved 10% higher engagement than the previous Shop the Look experience.
